transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… I’m not sure if this is the right sort of thing to come in for, but my husband thought it might help if I talked to someone. It’s about our kitchen, really. For almost two years now I’ve been convinced the contractor and a few people on our block have been sort of… working together, quietly, to cheat us. 

I know that may sound a little much, and my husband keeps showing me receipts and they all have explanations, but it still feels like they’ve kept things half-wrong on purpose. I just can’t shake it.
Do you think these people are trying to harm you or your family in any way?

I don’t think they’re trying to hurt us, not like physically or anything. I wouldn’t want you to think I mean that.

It’s more that I feel sure they’ve been quietly working together to cheat us… the contractor and some people on the block. Like they’ve kept the kitchen half-wrong on purpose, and every time my husband shows me receipts or says there’s an explanation, it just still doesn’t sit right with me. Maybe that sounds silly, but that’s what it feels like.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe the contractor and your neighbors were working together to cheat you?

Not really… I mean, I’ve tried to tell myself maybe I’m making too much of it, because my husband does show me receipts and there’s always some reason given. But even then, underneath, I still feel sure something’s been going on.

For nearly two years now, I’ve felt the contractor and some people on our block have been quietly working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. I wish I didn’t think that, truly… but I can’t say there’s really been a time I stopped believing it.
Has your belief that the contractor and your neighbors are working together to cheat you ever changed in intensity?

It does go up and down a bit, I suppose. Some days I can put it to the side and tell myself maybe I’m being too sensitive about the whole kitchen situation.

But then something reminds me—one of their explanations, or my husband showing me another receipt—and it comes back pretty strongly. Underneath, I’m still sure the contractor and some people on the block have been working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. I know that may not sound reasonable, but that’s honestly how it feels.
Do you have similar feelings of being cheated or conspired against in other areas of your life, outside of the kitchen situation?

No, not really… I mean, I don’t go around thinking everyone is against me, if that’s what you mean.

It’s mostly just this kitchen situation. For nearly two years I’ve felt sure the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us and keep it half-wrong on purpose. Even when my husband shows me receipts, or they give explanations, I still can’t shake it.

I hope that answers what you’re asking.
Has your belief that the contractor and your neighbors are working together to cheat you affected your daily routine or relationships with others?

A little, yes… I don’t want to make it sound like I can’t function or anything. I still do my normal things.

But I have stopped trusting certain neighbors, and workers too. I’m more guarded with them than I used to be. And my husband has had to take over more of the remodeling decisions, because I keep questioning what people are really doing and whether we’re being led around somehow.

I know that probably sounds difficult for him… I’m trying not to make it worse.
Have you ever considered the possibility that your beliefs about the contractor and neighbors might be incorrect?

I’ve tried to consider it, yes… I don’t want to seem stubborn or unreasonable.

My husband has shown me receipts, and people have given explanations, and I do tell myself maybe I’m missing something. But honestly, after nearly two years of this, I still feel sure the contractor and some people on the block have been working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose.

I know that may not be the answer you’re hoping for, but that’s where I am with it.
Was there anything unusual or stressful happening in your life around the time you first started feeling that the contractor and your neighbors were working together to cheat you?

Well… yes, I suppose the remodeling itself was the stressful part. I don’t want to make too much of it, but when the kitchen and the garden work started, the house was really disrupted, and that’s around when I first started feeling something wasn’t right.

It’s been about… a year and nine months now, I think. Almost two years. I hope that makes sense as an answer.
Do you think it's possible for you to change your mind about the contractor and your neighbors cheating you, or do you feel that you will always believe this?

I’d like to say I could change my mind, because I know that would probably sound better.

But… if I’m being honest, I don’t really see how. I’ve felt sure for nearly two years that the contractor and some of the neighbors have been quietly working together to cheat us, and to keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. Even when my husband shows me receipts or they give explanations, it doesn’t really settle it for me.

I’m not trying to be difficult. I just… still believe it.
Do you think there's any amount of evidence or proof that could make you stop believing the contractor and your neighbors are working together to cheat you?

I suppose… I’d like to think there would be some proof that could settle it, because I don’t want to sound like I’m being impossible.

But honestly, I don’t know what it would be. My husband has shown me receipts, and the contractor has had explanations, and neighbors act like nothing is going on… but it still doesn’t change what I feel certain about. For nearly two years now I’ve been sure they’ve been quietly working together to cheat us and leave the kitchen wrong on purpose.

I know that probably sounds rigid. I’m sorry. It’s just hard for me to imagine evidence that would make me stop believing it.
Do you think your belief about the contractor and neighbors cheating you could ever change, even a little bit, or do you feel it's something you'll always be certain about?

I mean… I don’t want to say “never,” because that probably sounds bad. I’d like to be the kind of person who can be reasonable about it.

But right now, no, I don’t really feel it could change much. I’m here because for almost two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us and keep my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts, they give explanations, and I try to listen… but it doesn’t move the feeling much.

So I suppose I’m still certain. I’m sorry if that’s not the answer I’m supposed to give.
Have you noticed any changes in your relationships with friends or family members who are not involved with the remodeling or your neighborhood?

No, not really… at least I don’t think so. I mean, outside of anything to do with the remodel or the neighborhood, I still keep up with my usual things.

I go to my church gatherings, and I still do my book club. I keep the house routines going, and we still make family plans the way we normally would. So I wouldn’t say my relationships with people outside all of this have changed much. I try to keep those parts of life normal.
Do you think your belief about the contractor and neighbors cheating you is based on facts or is it just a feeling you have?

I’d like to say it’s all facts, because I don’t want it to sound like I’m just being stubborn or emotional. There are things that made me notice it, and once I saw the pattern, it felt… very clear to me.

But I know my husband would say the facts don’t prove it. He shows me receipts, and the contractor always has some explanation, and the neighbors act like it’s nothing. Still, for nearly two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block have been working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose.

So… I suppose to other people it may sound like a feeling. But to me it feels like I know.
How much distress does thinking about the contractor and neighbors cheating you cause you right now?

Right now… I’d say it bothers me quite a bit, though I try not to make too much of it. I know people probably think I’m letting it get to me.

But when I think about it — that for nearly two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on the block have been quietly working together to cheat us and keep my kitchen half-wrong on purpose — it really does upset me. Even when my husband shows me receipts, or they give their explanations, it doesn’t calm me down much.

I don’t want to sound dramatic, but it’s hard to set it aside. It sits with me.
